brief.headline: HSBC launches regulated RedCoin stablecoin for PayMe users
brief.detail: HSBC launched a regulated stablecoin called RedCoin for 3.3 million PayMe users and payments at 100,000 merchants, a story covered by 25 outlets.

brief.headline: OpenAI targets $1.25 trillion valuation in new funding round
brief.detail: OpenAI is targeting a $1.25 trillion valuation in a new funding round, as a rout in the AI trade faded and gave global stock investors some respite.

brief.headline: Jio's record IPO draws strong demand despite India market rout
brief.detail: Jio Platforms' $3.1 billion IPO drew strong institutional demand, defying an India market rout and making it the country's biggest-ever share sale.

brief.headline: BASF raises Evonik takeover bid to over €11 billion
brief.detail: BASF has boosted its takeover offer for Evonik Industries to more than €11 billion ($12.3 billion), according to people familiar with the matter.

brief.headline: Euro sinks on French debt worries as yen gains on AI rout
brief.detail: The euro fell on French debt worries while the yen gained during an AI-driven rout, a currency move relevant to traders watching global markets.
